title: Bet365 Launches Bonus Promotions Attracting Bettors Early in the Season.
seoTitle: Bet365 Launches Bonus Promotions Attracting Bettors Early
subtitle: The sportsbook highlights special offers for MLB, NFL, and other sports during the first weeks of competition
excerpt: With promotions offering up to $200 in free bets after a $10 first deposit, bet365 stands out among sports fans looking to maximize their betting power.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: RotoWire, 930 WFMD Free Talk, Broncos Wire
contentHtml:
With the opening of the baseball season and the third round of the NFL, bet365 has announced new promotions that allow bettors to receive up to $200 in bonus bets when making a first deposit of just $10. The offer has generated significant interest among fans looking to expand their betting power without committing too much of their own money.

How the $200 Bonus Promotion Works

A $10 bet on any market guarantees the new user $200 in bonus bets, regardless of the outcome of the first wager. The credit is credited as soon as the initial bet is settled and can be used within seven days, on bets with odds of -500 or more favorable.

Special Offer for the MLB Season

For baseball fans, bet365 offers $365 in bonuses to be used throughout the season. The promotion is linked to the MLB game calendar, allowing bettors to take advantage of the 15 daily games on a typical summer Sunday.

Additional Benefits: Safety Net and Streaming Options

In addition to the $200 bonus, the sportsbook offers a “First Bet Safety Net” option of up to $1,000. If the first bet loses, the wagered amount is returned as a bonus. The platform also includes live streaming of thousands of events, covering everything from the Premier League to international tennis tournaments.

Availability in American States

bet365 operates legally in sixteen states, including Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, and Virginia. Users must be of legal age and reside in one of these states to take advantage of the promotions.

Registration Process and Bonus Usage

To claim the offer, interested parties must access the bet365 website, click “Bet now,” and follow the registration steps. After confirming the account, simply deposit $10 and choose the desired bet. The $200 or $365 credit will be automatically credited and can be applied to any sport available on the platform.

Considerations Regarding Deposits and Withdrawals

Minimum deposits are typically $10. Withdrawals via PayPal are processed within 24 hours; debit cards and bank transfers can take 3 to 5 business days. No fees are charged by bet365, although financial institutions may apply their own costs.
